response.original_title: It's Not a Prison If You Never Try the Door
response.overview: "Multi-hyphenate Solondz creates a remediated, glitch-filled revision of a monster classic. As pixels melt, stick and stutter, Godzilla arises and the world decays, a startling vision of mutation and destruction."  - Chi-hui Yang.  Commissioned by Heliopolis gallery for ZERO LAND.
response.tagline: "It looks like Godzilla, but due to international copyright laws - it's not."
response.title: It's Not a Prison If You Never Try the Door

release_dates.note: Commissioned for and screened at the ZERO LAND exhibition at the Heliopolis Gallery in Greenpoint, NY: https://rachaelrakes.com/ZERO-LAND
